nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule

avis.texte: This is a really nice serum that makes your skin glow and helps with dark spots. It is very thick and can be sticky for 15-20 minutes after applying it but it goes away. It pairs really well with the Madagascar Centella probio-cica enrich cream. I use those two products along with the peach & lily good acid toner and have noticed significant improvement in my skin texture, pores, and overall skin tone.

I love that this product had no irritating ingredients or scents for my very sensitive skin. I used it for quite a while and did start to notice a slight lightening of my PIE. It's nice and lightweight for layering with other products and I would recommend it to someone like me who have very sensitive and acne prone skin and who is dealing with PIE. It may not be enough on its own, but it's a lovely addition

I received the Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule to review, and the product had no scent, which I really appreciated. It's lightweight, calming, absorbs quickly, and helps my complexion look more even and refreshed without irritation. Definitely worth the price for a gentle, effective brightening ampoule.
I really liked this product! It made my skin feel so soft and smooth while brightening my uneven skin tone! Even my acne scars are looking better!

I've been using this product for a few weeks now and have enjoyed it as part of my skin care routine. While I haven't experienced noticeable changes to my skin tone, my skin feels incredibly soft and smooth after application. It's my "glass skin" product now. I like that this provides another layer of hydration before my moisturizer and works well with other products - no pilling. I think it's a great value as a few drops go a long way. I received this product for my honest opinion.

I have pretty sensitive, fair skin that is prone to redness. I really enjoyed how gentle this ampoule is on my skin and especially that there's no detectable fragrance. It absorbed quickly into my skin and my foundation applied over it without any issues. My skin feels super soft after using it and it helps to even out the redness. Overall, I'm happy with this product in my routine. I received this product as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Good Brightening, Just Not My Favorite Texture
avis.texte: I like what this ampoule does for my skin, but I don't totally love how it feels. It definitely helps calm my skin and gives a nice brightening effect over time, which I really appreciate. My skin looks more even and healthy when I use it consistently.

avis.titre: Love it!! Goodbye to my forehead lines
avis.texte: I have about three very noticeable lines on my forehead, and I think that area was so dehydrated that this product was able to seriously diminish my noticeable lines on my forehead. This product hydrates the area so well without the consequences of pimples or blackheads. The texture is not oily and easy to massage into the skin. I love that the formula has no smell.

avis.titre: I will definitely be repurchase this product again!
avis.texte: I've been using this product for day and night. I use a hydrating toner first and go in with my other serums, I use this as my last serum. I really like how this product has even out my redness, my acne scars are staying to lighten up. I do like that this product has no scent. The bottle will last for a long while too!

I wanted to give this product a chance so I've been using it for the passed 3 weeks or so. I do like this Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule. This has niacinamide, tranexamic Acid which provides hydration and evening out your skin tone. Centella Asiatica Extract is rich in antioxidants. Also has healing and hydrating properties. I noticed a difference in the levels of hydration. And I slight difference in my dark spots. The texture is light and almost watery once you blend it into your skin. There is a slight tackiness after applying. The beads in the serum blend in right away. Packaging is basic and pretty. There is a slight fragrance to it but it's probably from the ingredients. I received this product for my honest opinion.
i love this! it brightens my face and makes me feel brand new

I received the Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule for free in exchange for my honest review. After using it consistently for about 3 weeks, I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's brightness and overall smoothness. The packaging is really nice! I received the 50 ml bottle and the dropper is so easy to use. The texture is a lightweight gel with tiny capsules that melt effortlessly into the skin without feeling sticky, no greasy feeling after and I have oily/combo skin. It feels very comfortable upon application and has a slightly cooling sensation that's refreshing, especially during my skincare routine. Overall, it absorbs well and leaves my skin looking more even and healthy.

I received this product for free through BzzAgent. • I used this tone brightening capsule ampoule for almost 4 weeks. • It did brighten my overall skin tone, and I noticed a slight lightening effect, but it did not completely remove my freckles. • I really like the texture of this product. • It feels like a light aloe vera gel and is not sticky. • At first, it feels a little tacky for a few seconds, but once absorbed, it becomes very comfortable on the skin. • Unlike other serums I've tried, this one doesn't feel too cold and stays at a comfortable temperature. • My skin feels hydrated, plump, and more youthful-looking after using it. • I also use it on my hands like a hand lotion, and I noticed my hands appear less wrinkly and smoother. • When applying one or two layers, the capsules melt well into the skin. • When applying three layers, some of the beads do not fully melt. • I think the capsules melt with skin temperature, and after multiple layers, the skin cools down, causing some beads to remain. • The product did not cause any pimples or breakouts, which is very important to me. • It also helps soothe the skin, especially when I have a healing pimple. • Overall, this ampoule works well for brightening, hydration, and comfort, but it's more for subtle improvement rather than dramatic freckle removal.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. The Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule is easily one of my favorites in rotation. Typically my skin leans more sensitive but this product didn't irritate me at all. Although, I haven't been using this for an extended period of time I can still tell a difference in my overall skins clarity and brightness. I still find that I need additional measures for hydration but I am satisfied with this ampoules results thus far. I would highly recommend giving this a try!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I was initially impressed with the way the serum was packaged. The product comes in a nice glass bottle. I looked up the price of the item and was pleasantly surprised by the value of the product as well. As for how the serum performs. I have been using this product for about two weeks now and I feel as though it does help my skin appear brighter. I like the way it feels when it goes on. It feels like it adds moisture to my skin without a heavy or greasy feeling and it absorbs well. Also, my skin is prone to breakouts and this has not caused any skin irritaion or breakout, so that is a huge win for me. I am really happy to have been introduced to this product!
Love this so far, helping the tone of my skin. Good for sensitive skin too
This product was amazing! I loved how it went on and made my skin feel. I also noticed a difference much sooner than other products I've used in the past.

avis.titre: A Gentle Ampoule for Clearer-Looking Skin
avis.texte: I've been using this ampoule for a while now, and it's become an easy product to reach for in my daily routine. The texture feels very light and comfortable on the skin. It has tiny capsules that melt as soon as you spread it, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or heavy feeling. My skin feels soft and hydrated right after applying, with a healthy glow that doesn't look oily. What I noticed most is how calm my skin feels while using it. Even on days when my skin is a bit tired or sensitive, it still feels balanced and comfortable. With regular use, my complexion looks clearer and more even, and dullness slowly improves. Dark spots don't disappear overnight, but they do look lighter over time. I like that this ampoule works gently. It doesn't cause irritation, breakouts, or dryness, and it layers well with the rest of my skincare. It's the kind of product that focuses on steady, natural-looking improvement rather than dramatic, instant results. This is a good choice if you're looking for something you can use every day to help your skin look brighter, smoother, and healthier over time.
I use this every day. It is very hydrating and I can see how it would provide brightening the longer you use it. It adds a really nice glow to my skin and my makeup goes on well over it!

avis.titre: It leaves my skin very moisturizing.
avis.texte: It is incredible how it looks to my skin, and how it leaves the finish, when I apply it and dry my skin feels very firm and soft and looks very radiant, which helps it to look very moisturizing and luminous.

I've been using this for about 3 weeks now (& there isn't even a dent in the bottle) & I absolutely love it. I love to use it before makeup as a primer cause the stickiness helps my foundation stay put. It absorbs beautifully, it pairs well with my retinol & I didn't purge, my dry patches are gone. My black heads are almost non existent. My skin feels so much softer & brighter. No weird pilling or anything like that. This would 100% be a repurchase for me. It's worked great for me & I love it. This brand has become my entire skincare routine & I'm very content.

I received this item as a free sample. The bottle has a luxurious design. The formula is lightweight and slightly tacky, making it easy to layer and mix with other products. I really love the design, and after looking into the ingredients, I feel even more reassured.

I Received this tone brightening capsule ampoule for free in exchange for an honest review. After using this for a few weeks I've noticed my skin feeling more hydrated and looking brighter. I like that it contains niacinamide and it is fragrance free. The bottle looks and feels nice and the dropper makes it easy to apply.

avis.titre: I love this product, one of my favs
avis.texte: I used this every night before bed time ! I loved it it make it bright ❤️
I love the product; it's lightweight and doesn't leave the skin greasy. Plus, it moisturizes and leaves a beautiful, natural glow.
Love the formula and how lightweight it feels but how hydrating it still is
Great brightening serum. Didn't cause any irritation or discomfort. The serum is not sticky, absorbs well and has no smell at all. I love the little white buds inside that metl on your skin.

SKIN1004 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. It says it brightens skin and it really does! I noticed a difference in brightening within a few days of use. It is not however super hydrating. It wasn't a drying product, but it does not hydrate if that's what you are looking for.
This has been such a great addition to my nighttime routine. It leaves my skin smooth and glowing the next morning. I have super sensitive skin and have no experienced any side affects or irritation.

This product felt lovely on my skin and left my skin feeling hydrated. This formula helped my skin texture and made my skin look brighter. I love the bottle and I will continue to use this in my routine

avis.titre: Gentle Brightening Ampoule That Works Wonders on Sensitive S
avis.texte: Disclosure: I received this product for free as part of a sample program, but these opinions are my own. I have sensitive skin, so I'm always cautious when trying new serums or ampoules. The Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule ended up being a really pleasant surprise. Compared to other brightening products I've tried—many of which can feel harsh or leave my skin irritated—this one is noticeably gentler. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers well with the rest of my routine without pilling or causing redness. One of the biggest benefits of owning this product is how calming it feels while still delivering a subtle brightening effect. My skin looks more even and feels soothed, especially on days when it's extra reactive. I also appreciate that it plays nicely with both my hydrating products and active treatments, which isn't always the case with brightening formulas. Would I buy this product? Yes. After finishing the sample, I'd be happy to purchase the full size because it fits seamlessly into my routine and actually works for my sensitive skin. And yes—I would absolutely recommend it to friends or family, especially anyone who wants a brightening product without the irritation.

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule for a while now, and I'm really happy with the results. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. My skin looks noticeably brighter and more even, and the centella helps calm any redness or irritation. It's gentle enough for daily use, and I like that it gives a healthy, natural glow. Overall, a great brightening serum for sensitive skin.

I am so happy I received this product in exchange for my honest review, because if I had not, I might have missed out on this amazing brand and product! Seriously, my skin feels so supple and moisturized. I am noticing a difference in fine lines on my face after a few weeks of use, they are a lot less noticeable. I love the texture of this serum, it's refreshing on my skin and doesn't leave me feeling greasy. This is a great product and I'm extremely happy with the results I am seeing.
I loved the glass bottle it came in, it has a sticky texture but fades away in a minute, my skin feels hydrated, it's lightweight, and noticed my skin look brighter and healthier.

This serum has been super gentle on my skin. It sinks in fast, keeps my redness down, and gives a soft, natural glow over time. Nothing dramatic overnight, but it's one of those products that just quietly makes your skin look better the longer you use it.

I received this product for free from Skin1004 in exchange for my honest review. The serum feels a little sticky at first, but it absorbs quickly and has a nice cooling effect without any irritation. So far, it's been a pleasant addition to my routine. I'm still waiting to see how well it works on fading dark spots, but overall it's a solid, gentle serum.

I don't think the product is bad, it's just not for me. I've tried several other products from this brand and they have all broken me out instantly. I thought I would give this one one last try but it also unfortunately broke me out.

avis.titre: Perfect addition to my nighttime skin care routine!
avis.texte: I really like the way this serum feels. After washing my face, I use a full dropper and work it evenly around my skin. It has tiny capsules that sit nicely on the surface and absorb really well. My face looks brighter and feels deeply moisturized afterward.

Lightweight, calming, and gentle. It brightens gradually and helps even tone, but don't expect dramatic dark-spot fading on its own. Good for sensitive or combo skin that wants steady, irritation-free improvement.

This stuff came in a big bottle. This stuff is sticky like glue. I cannot even apply foundation with this on my face. This and the cream are really sticky. I touch my face and my finger sticks to it. Horrible.

avis.titre: I would love to buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I've been using the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Ampoule, and I honestly love it. It feels so light on my skin and absorbs quickly. After a few uses, my face looks calmer and a bit brighter. The little capsules melt right in and make my skin feel fresh. I'm really happy with how gentle and effective it is.

The consistency of the serum is lightweight and not sticky at all on the face. It absorbs quickly and is effective on brightening your skin when you are using it consistently. Will repurchase this serum.
I've only been using it for 4 days and have already noticed my dark spots starting the lighten and my skin getting brighter.

avis.titre: Excellent hydrating serum with an awesome price
avis.texte: I love this stuff! It's super hydrating without weighing my skin down and it looks great under makeup. It gives me a beautiful glow and my skin soaks it up! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule for a few weeks, and I'm really impressed. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky feeling. It calms my skin instantly while adding a natural, healthy glow. My redness has noticeably reduced, and my skin tone looks more even. Overall, it's a gentle but effective brightening treatment I would happily repurchase.
